# schematic design

found cool mcu with native usb connector(esp32-s3-mini-1). would have liked to use c-series cause risc-v but... it's fine...

worked on organizing left and right schematics seperately.

here i ran into issue where i had them in hierarchical sheets at first. but then my dumb brain
